title: [finding] The whole `report.editor.*` namespace — 106 keys × 10 packs — has no consumer left; the report editor it labelled became the spec-driven inspector
body:
Measured while implementing #4118 (PR #4137), **not fixed there** — that card's fence is the seven wrong-slot call sites, and this is a namespace-liveness question, not a wrong-copy defect. Filed so the measurement does not stay buried in a PR.

## The measurement

`report.editor` in `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` spans lines 1052–1165 and holds **106 leaf keys** (`breadcrumb`, `basic`, `title`, `titlePlaceholder`, `description`, `type`, `typeTabular`, `data`, `objectName`, `limit`, `columns`, `filters`, `groupBy`, `rows`, `values`, `grouping`, `dateGranularity`, `chart`, `chartType`, …). All ten packs carry the set (`all-locales-key-parity` owns that), so it is roughly **1060 translated strings**.

Repo-wide, the number of call sites that read any of them is **zero**:

```
$ grep -rn "report\.editor\." packages/ apps/ examples/ scripts/ | grep -v packages/i18n
packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx        (comments only, after #4137)
packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ReportConfigPanel.panelTitle.test.tsx
packages/components/CHANGELOG.md
packages/plugin-report/CHANGELOG.md
```

Not a dynamic-key blind spot either: there is no `t(\`report.editor.${…}\`)` anywhere, and no JSON/MDX metadata references the namespace. `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` reports 62 dynamic-key sites repo-wide and none of them are in this family.

Spot-checked individually, each returns 0 non-test, non-locale call sites: `basic`, `description`, `type`, `data`, `columns`, `filters`, `groupBy`, `chart`, `breadcrumb`.

## Why it went dormant

The namespace was built for the hand-rolled report editor form — the CHANGELOG entries read "All editor labels and hints are i18n-driven (`report.editor.*`)". That form is gone: `ReportConfigPanel`'s body is now `ReportDefaultInspector`, a spec-driven inspector whose labels come from the report spec's own metadata, not from this pack namespace. `ReportConfigPanel.tsx:55` still calls its remaining catalog "Legacy field catalog for the pre-9.0 object-bound report editor."

Until #4137 the namespace had exactly **one** live reader — and it was the bug #4118 is about: the panel borrowing `report.editor.title` (the Title *field's* label) to name itself. Moving that slot to a purpose-built `report.editor.panelTitle` left `panelTitle` as the namespace's only consumed key and the other 106 with nothing reading them.

## Why no gate sees it

Every i18n gate in the repo runs **call site → key**, never key → call site:

- `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` asks whether each call site's key resolves in `en`. A key with no call site is not a call site, so it is never visited.
- `all-locales-key-parity` compares the ten packs' key *sets* to each other. 106 keys present in all ten packs is exactly what it wants.
- `scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` only fires when an `en` value *changes*. These values are static.

So the packs can accumulate dead namespaces indefinitely with every gate green — the mirror image of #3810 / #4117 (dead *fallbacks* at live call sites); this is live *keys* with dead call sites.

## Impact — observation class, nothing a user hits today

No user reads a wrong string because of this; the keys simply never render. The cost is carrying cost and misdirection:

- ~1060 strings across ten packs that translators maintain and reviewers diff for nothing.
- The next agent reasoning "what does this key mean" from pack neighbours reads a namespace that describes a UI that no longer exists — which is precisely the inference chain that produced #4118's defect.

## Suggested direction (not a ruling)

Two candidates, and the choice needs a maintainer:

1. **Retire the namespace** — if the spec-driven inspector is the settled direction, `report.editor.*` minus `panelTitle` is dead weight; delete from all ten packs.
2. **Keep it deliberately** — if the hand-rolled editor is meant to come back, or some downstream consumer outside this repo reads the packs, retire nothing and record why.

Worth deciding as a class rather than one namespace: a "no key without a reader" gate (key → call site, allowlisted for deliberate exceptions) is what would stop the next namespace going dormant unnoticed. That is the broader change and should be its own card if wanted.

Related: #4118 / PR #4137 (where this surfaced — the last live reader), #3810 and #4117 (dead fallbacks at live call sites — the mirror direction), #3546 (the ten-pack key discipline).
